image_description: A close-up studio shot of an intricate, chunky beaded necklace against a plain white background. The necklace features large, textured blue beads with metallic accents, smaller amber and green glass beads, and a central orange oval pendant with a floral or starburst pattern. Silver-toned metal findings and wire-wrapping connect the various components.
